summary: For the legal finite-fragment source E_N=union_k[4^k,4^k+1/N], after conditioning U=X-X' the exact cap M_N(U) lies in [N/2,N] on an event of probability (3/4)(1-1/N). Therefore for r independent pairs and any coordinatewise nondecreasing cap-only certificate F with the unavoidable quadratic common-scale homogeneity F(tM)=t^2F(M), E F(M_1,...,M_r) is at least [(3/4)(1-1/N)]^r (N^2/4)F(1,...,1). Thus no monotone cap-only anisotropic repackaging can make the conjugate-conditioning proof uniform; retain unnormalized overlap/phase geometry. This is not a QFORM counterexample.
